issues.jp_before: 準備[じゅんび]が{できたら|cd-volition}、声[こえ]をかけてください。
issues.problem: English 'please call out to me' is an unnatural rendering of 声をかけてください.
issues.action: English changed to 'When you are ready, please let me know.'

issues.jp_before: 店[みせ]が{開[あ]いたら|cd-volition}、すぐ並[なら]ぼう。
issues.problem: Illogical scene: you queue before a shop opens, not after; with that logic the distractor 開くなら ('if it is going to open, let's line up') becomes the sensible reading.
issues.action: Main clause changed to すぐ入[はい]ろう / 'let's go in'.

issues.jp_before: 頭[あたま]が{痛[いた]いなら/痛[いた]かったら|cd-volition}、今日[きょう]は休[やす]んでください。
issues.problem: 痛ければ is just as natural before a request (stative predicate) but was not listed as an alternative.
issues.action: Added 痛[いた]ければ as an alternative; why updated.

issues.jp_before: 気分[きぶん]が{悪[わる]ければ/悪[わる]かったら|cd-volition}、すぐ言[い]ってください。
issues.problem: 悪いなら is equally natural here but was not listed.
issues.action: Added 悪[わる]いなら as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: {眠[ねむ]ければ/眠[ねむ]かったら|cd-volition}、先[さき]に寝[ね]てもいいよ。
issues.problem: 眠いなら is equally (arguably more) natural here but was not listed.
issues.action: Added 眠[ねむ]いなら as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: お金[かね]が{貯[た]まったら|cd-volition}、旅行[りょこう]に行[い]きたいです。
issues.problem: lv 2 too high; 貯まる and the grammar are about N3.
